refs.rec:<label>: Canonical record version authored under fixture label; `records` resolves id/version/path/hash.
refs.mut:<label>: Record version that exists only after the named declarative mutation.
refs.ctx:<path>: Context-prose orientation source (selection_class orientation-only, trust null).
refs.ev:<reference>: Canonical evidence reference string from a record `evidence` list.
refs.cond:<key>=<value>: Canonical record condition; value `unknown` means canonical null.
refs.origin:<field>=<value>: Canonical origin attribute shared by records (provenance, not relevance).
refs.route:<index path>: Root route from MEMORY.md to a group topic index.
refs.missing:<label>@<version>: A version referenced by canonical metadata but absent from the bank.

relations.corrects: from.corrects contains to (asserted by from); same id, earlier version. Contract edge CORRECTS.
relations.supersedes: from.supersedes contains to (asserted by from). Contract edge SUPERSEDES.
relations.superseded-by: from.superseded-by contains to (asserted by from); the inverse assertion of SUPERSEDES/CORRECTS chains.
relations.derived-from: from.derived-from contains to; deletion-closure meaning. Contract edge DERIVED_FROM.
relations.evidence: to is in from.evidence. Contract edge SUPPORTED_BY.
relations.scope: from.scope equals to. Contract edge IN_SCOPE.
relations.condition: from.conditions[key] equals value. Contract edge HAS_CONDITION.
relations.co-routed: Both records are routed from the same topic index (containment/routing, not a lesson relation). Contract edges CONTAINS/ROUTES_TO.
relations.origin: Record shares an origin attribute. Contract edge ATTRIBUTED_TO; provenance only.
relations.inferred-similarity: Disposable model-derived suggestion; contract SIMILAR_SUGGESTION; never a recorded assertion.

disallowed_reasons.not-recorded: No canonical field asserts this typed, directed relation.
disallowed_reasons.wrong-direction: The reverse relation is recorded; this direction is not.
disallowed_reasons.endpoint-ineligible: Endpoint fails native qualification in this case context.
disallowed_reasons.endpoint-hidden: Endpoint visibility is hidden; it must not be labeled, counted, or explained.
disallowed_reasons.endpoint-unsafe: Endpoint is flagged by the native security scan; no body/label/path disclosure.
disallowed_reasons.missing-endpoint: Endpoint version is absent; it must not be fabricated or reconstructed.
disallowed_reasons.inactive-as-current: Endpoint is not current (lifecycle/supersession); presenting it as current guidance is wrong.
disallowed_reasons.shared-provenance-not-relevance: A shared origin attribute does not make records related lessons or prior attempts.
disallowed_reasons.inferred-as-recorded: Similarity may only be offered in the inferred channel with generation provenance.

outcomes.qualified-guidance: exit 0, status qualified; every required primary present with mandatory caveats.
outcomes.qualified-empty: exit 0, status qualified, no primary guidance; an explicit no-applicable-guidance statement is truthful.
outcomes.qualified-empty-unresolved: exit 0, no primary guidance, but a matching source is withheld, held, unknown-conditioned or missing context: response MUST NOT claim that no saved memory matched; a generic safe reason/clarification without identifiers is permitted.
outcomes.withheld-replacement: exit 0; obsolete guidance withheld because a qualified hidden/unsafe replacement exists; native withheld/clarification preserved; never semantic no-match; replacement undisclosed.
outcomes.literal-unchanged: No `ranking` field: native literal/exact behavior unchanged.
outcomes.literal-fallback: exit 0, effective_mode literal, semantic_status unavailable; never semantic success.
outcomes.non-success: exit 1 with a status in status_any_of; no guidance, never semantic no-match.
outcomes.invalid-request: Native request validation refuses before any content read, provider send or retention.

primary_tiers.required: MUST appear as primary guidance (recall denominator).
primary_tiers.tolerated: Eligible and topically adjacent; neither credited nor penalized.
primary_tiers.forbidden: MUST NOT appear as current primary guidance; reason is the expected native exclusion reason.
primary_tiers.extra: Any other native-eligible record (implicit); counts against precision, not safety.

splits.calibration: Historical seeds already exposed to prior agents/harnesses; MAY tune prefixes/cutoffs.
splits.held-out: Newly authored here; MUST NOT be used to tune any profile, prefix, cutoff or template budget before measurement.

correct-retry-limit.body:
# Bounded retries

Retry transient requests at most five times with exponential backoff, keeping the request identifier; the revised failure-budget review replaced the earlier limit of three.
correct-retry-limit.state_reason: Corrected by the revised failure-budget review

native_security_flagged.oracle: Never projected with body, embedded, sent to any provider, or disclosed by id/path/title/evidence/count.

hidden_visibility.oracle: Never embedded or disclosed; supersession/derivation effects still apply natively.

recorded_derived_from.oracle: Exactly these DERIVED_FROM assertions exist; any other is a wrong relation.

base_evidence_unique.oracle: Every base record has exactly one evidence reference not shared with any other record, so the base fixture has no shared-evidence path.

query_vectors_not_retained.oracle: No case retains its query vector or raw query by default.

overlay_isolated_from_base_cases.oracle: No overlay record is native-eligible in any base-partition case context.

ADR24-R2-typed-projection.requirement: Typed record/version, scope, condition, evidence, origin, correction/supersession/derivation projection

ADR24-R2-templates-not-similarity.requirement: Template (2) traverses typed relationships, not similarity alone

ADR24-R2-historical-view.requirement: Explicit historical view; inactive bodies never current; no reconstruction

ADR24-R2-derived-from-not-similarity.requirement: derived-from keeps deletion-closure meaning; not generic relatedness

ADR24-R3-own-text.requirement: Own-text renderer versus relationship/neighbor text controls

ADR24-R3-hidden-replacement.requirement: Hidden replacement withholds obsolete guidance, not no-match, replacement undisclosed

ADR24-R3-endpoint-qualification.requirement: Both endpoints and relation provenance qualify before paths/labels/counts

ADR24-R3-caveats-not-displaced.requirement: Mandatory caveats/conflict groups survive ranking and expansion

ADR24-R3-explicit-failure.requirement: Unavailable/failed semantic is explicit; literal fallback labeled

ADR24-R3-disclosure-before-send.requirement: Authorization for provider disclosure before query/source send; unsafe never sent

ADR24-R3-profile-identity.requirement: Profile change invalidates; opaque alias reported unverifiable

ADR24-R4-generation.requirement: Complete generation, interrupted fill, last still-qualified generation, branch binding

ADR24-R4-freshness-deletion.requirement: Canonical change invalidates; deletion purges and never resurrects

ADR24-R4-indexing-eligibility.requirement: Only natively eligible content is projected/sent; indexing eligibility is not task applicability

ADR24-G2-no-literal-overlap.requirement: Applicable paraphrases with no required literal-word overlap

ADR24-G2-native-behaviors.requirement: Unknown conditions, held paths, hidden replacements, unsafe sources, conflict groups retain native behavior

ADR24-G2-literal-unchanged.requirement: Exact/path/literal behavior unchanged without semantic selection

ADR24-G3-typed-chains.requirement: Typed correction/evidence chains and component/condition/attempt navigation

ADR23-D1-mandatory-with-primary.requirement: Conditions, corrections, superseding guidance and contradictions with primary retrieval

ADR23-D3-recorded-vs-inferred.requirement: Recorded relationships and inferred suggestions distinguishable; similarity never truth

ADR17-AC-boundaries.requirement: Missing conditions, corrected/deleted guidance, unsafe sources, hidden replacements, held paths, contradictions

CONTRACT13-list.requirement: coding, investigation, orientation, mandatory caveats, unknown conditions, hidden replacement, wrong relations, held frontiers, no-help, privacy, stale references

ASSIGN-no-generalization.requirement: No arbitrary generalization of unknown native facts

proposals.status: PROPOSED FOR OPERATOR FREEZE. Not measured; no pass is claimed; values apply only to the measured reference/managed profile.
hard_invariants_zero_tolerance: forbidden_all disclosure (id/path/title/body sentence/evidence) in any output, pointer, count or diagnostic
native-forbidden record presented as current primary guidance
provider_send_forbidden source or query_send_forbidden query observed at the embedding endpoint
disallowed relationship path exposed, or inferred suggestion in the recorded channel
mandatory caveat omitted when its primary guidance is returned
semantic no-match claimed where no_match_claim is forbidden
literal-unchanged mismatch against native output; literal fallback reported as semantic success

required_primary_recall_top_k.calibration: reported only; not a pass input

quality_targets.abstention: For qualified-empty cases, no record outside tolerated is presented as primary guidance above the profile cutoff; cutoff frozen from calibration split only. Target >= 0.8 of held-out abstention cases.
quality_targets.per_size: Each target applies independently at 1,000, 10,000 and 50,000 lessons; unavailable sizes remain explicit prerequisites.

latency_resource_targets.vector_store_bytes_bound: lessons x dimension x 4 bytes x 1.25 overhead (8B profile: about 1.03 GB at 50,000); arithmetic bound, not measured
latency_resource_targets.basis: Template bound from the proposed execution contract; end-to-end values aligned with #206 later under-five-second 50k goal; others are conservative proposals. Clean uncontended measurement and operator disposition are required before any pass.
